description.zh:
任务使用的节点类型。取值：

- PC：PC端探测点。

- MOBILE：移动端探测点。

- FC：内网探测点
description.en:
The type of detection points used by the task. Valid values:

- PC: PC-based detection points.

- MOBILE: mobile-based detection points.

- FC: internal detection points.

description.zh:
查询站点监控任务的关键字。

> 支持根据任务名称或任务地址模糊搜索。
description.en:
The keyword used to search for site monitoring tasks.

> Fuzzy match is supported based on the task name or task address.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.
The ID of the site monitoring task.

description.zh:
任务状态。取值：

- 1：正常。

- 2：禁用。
description.en:
The task status. Valid values:

- 1: Normal.

- 2: Disabled.

description.zh: 站点监控任务探测类型。云监控支持的探测类型包括：HTTP 、PING 、TCP 、UDP 、DNS 、SMTP 、POP3 、FTP。
description.en: The type of the site monitoring task. CloudMonitor supports the following types: HTTP, PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP.

title.zh: 查询站点监控任务列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前账号的站点监控任务列表。返回结果显示，当前账号存在一条站点监控记录`HanZhou_ECS2`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example of how to query the list of site monitoring tasks for the current account. The response shows that the current account has one site monitoring task named `HanZhou_ECS2`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-site-monitor-list --task-id a1ecd34a-8157-44d9-b060-149508370000 --task-type HTTP --keyword site --page 1 --page-size 10 --task-state 1 --agent-group PC --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeSiteMonitorList --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 'a1ecd34a-8157-44d9-b060-149508370000' --Keyword site --PageSize 10 --TaskType HTTP --AgentGroup PC --Page 1 --TaskState 1
